title: Explore Japan | Journey to the Cultural Treasure Trove
highlights: Witness Japan's vibrant mix of tradition and modernity, from Tokyo’s bustling streets and cutting-edge technology to Osaka’s rich cultural heritage.
Soar above Hakone on the iconic Ropeway ride and take in panoramic views of Mount Fuji, lush valleys, and the serene Lake Ashi.
Explore Todaiji’s Great Buddha Hall, home to the world’s largest bronze Buddha statue, and get a profound insight into Japan’s rich cultural heritage.
Pay your respects at Kinkaku-ji, the iconic Buddhist temple in Kyoto, renowned for its dazzling gold leaf facade and beautiful surrounding gardens.
Soak in the futuristic allure of Odaiba District, with its iconic Rainbow Bridge, bustling shopping malls, and lively nightlife, offering a dynamic urban escape.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at the Narita International Airport, get driven to your hotel in Tokyo. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at your leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can take a leisurely walk through the lush greenery of Yoyogi Park or visit Sumida Park & soak-in the views of the Sumida River and Tokyo Skytree. Also, you can indulge in shopping in the Ginza district & more. Afterwards, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, head to Matsuya Ginza to board the bus to explore Tokyo on a sightseeing tour. Make your first stop to visit the Meiji Shrine, nestled in a lush forest. Next, admire the impressive architecture of the Imperial Palace. Continue your tour and visit Sensō-ji, Tokyo’s oldest Buddhist temple with rich historical significance. Also, visit other key attractions in the city before getting driven to Matsuya Ginza. Once there, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: Today, head to Shinjuku Love on your own and board your transfer to the majestic Mount Fuji. Upon arrival, ascend to the Subaru Line 5th Station and soak-in the breathtaking vistas of Japan’s highest mountain. Next, enjoy a scenic boat ride on Lake Ashi, followed by a thrilling ropeway journey in Hakone. Also, witness the bubbling hot springs in the Owakudani Valley. Later, get driven to Odawara Station and board your bullet train to Tokyo Station. From there, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, after check-out, head to Tokyo Station on your own and board the Shinkansen bullet train to Osaka (tickets provided). Upon reaching Osaka, head to your hotel and check-in. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit the Osaka Museum of History to uncover the city's past or enjoy the hands-on exhibits at the Osaka Science Museum. Also, you can get a taste of vibrant local culture at Den Den Town. Later, return to your hotel.

days.title: Day trip to Kyoto and Nara
days.desc: In the morning, head to the pick-up point at Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda on your own and board your transfer for a full-day trip to Kyoto and Nara. Start with a visit to the famous Kinkakuji Temple and admire its stunning architecture. Proceed to explore the historical Nijo Castle and visit the impressive Todaiji Temple. Next, enjoy the company of friendly deer in Nara Park, explore the Arashiyama District and more. Later, get driven to Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda and from there, return to your hotel.

days.desc: Today, after check-out, board your transfer for Narita International Airport. Upon reaching, board your flight back home, marking the end of your unforgettable Japan tour!
